title: Aurora Cinematic Asset Library v0.1
world_identity: Polar world covered by dynamic aurora-like spectral light waves
Ancient civilization remnants preserved beneath ice
Local fauna synchronizes biological rhythms and migration with light frequencies
Deep polar night and long restoration cycles
Neutral protected heritage region with cryogenic preservation structures
texture_spec: All PBR maps are 2048x2048 (2K); each set contains albedo, roughness, normal, height and AO.

production_notes: Models are modular procedural high-poly starter meshes, not finished hand-sculpted hero assets.
Texture maps are separate files and must be assigned to materials in Blender, Unreal or Unity.
No baked animation clips are included; fauna and flora are rigging-ready prototypes.
Aurora light curtains, volumetric atmosphere and moving spectral sky should be implemented in the target renderer using animated shaders/particles for cinematic results.
